posts.t: The Rangers are signing goalie James Reimer, who was released from his AHL PTO today with Hartford to make it happen.

threads.t: [LAK - NYR] Dylan Garand is playing in his 8th straight game after James Reimer was pulled just 20 minutes into the game. Reimer let in 3 goals on 9 shots.

[Mercogliano] NYR are signing James Reimer and placing him on the NHL roster, according to a source. Reimer had been on a PTO with Hartford, posting a 35-save shutout in his only appearance on Friday. Expect the NYR to…
